style: warm cream-pink hand-drawn home journal. Soft blush and apricot watercolour washes over warm off-white textured paper, colored-pencil and fine-liner outlines, visible paper grain, gentle drop shadows. Furniture drawn as friendly simplified top-down icons with warm wood tones and cream upholstery. The mood is a young homeowner's beautifully drawn keepsake page, not a sales-office poster and not a technical drawing.
composition: strict orthographic top-down 2D floor plan, no perspective, no isometric, no 3D. The plan fills the frame with generous even margins of blank paper on all four sides. Vertical portrait orientation.
negatives: furniture blocking a door opening or a main circulation path
adding rooms, islands, bathtubs, walk-in closets, gardens or gyms that are not in the source plan
dimension lines, measurement arrows, scale bars, north arrows, legends
